description: Source code for mkhash.c implementing MD5 and SHA256 hashing functions, including command-line interface for hashing files or stdin with options.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for command-line hashing utility, processes arguments, selects hash type, and hashes files or stdin.

methods.name: md5_hash
methods.description: Computes MD5 hash of a file or stdin.

methods.name: sha256_hash
methods.description: Computes SHA256 hash of a file or stdin.

methods.name: get_hash_type
methods.description: Retrieves hash_type struct based on hash name.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line utility.

methods.name: hash_file
methods.description: Hashes a specified file or stdin using the selected hash type.

methods.name: hash_buf
methods.description: Reads data from a file stream into a buffer.

methods.name: hash_string
methods.description: Converts hash bytes into a hexadecimal string.
